scope: Research portfolio and proposed large-alphabet negative Gaussian simplex proof, with the integrated preprint by Jitendra Prajapati. Partial Lean formalization includes actual prescribed Gaussian fan masses and offset Jacobian, polyhedral moments and quantitative Ehrhard covariance correction, Gaussian spectral/trace and weighted-facet components. The compiled source-module inventory audits 944 theorem constants (649 named declarations plus generated helpers). Attributed dependency audits include unchanged OpenAI Ehrhard sources and all 668 constants of the Tau Ceti singular-Schur closure. Only standard logical axioms appear in the audited proofs. The main theorem remains unproved in Lean; external review and priority clearance remain pending. The arXiv-compatible package has not been submitted to arXiv. Immutable releases and signed provenance record artifact identity and existence, not exclusive priority.
